title: console: no Setup or Studio menu entry opens the unfiltered Packages page, so disabling a code-loaded package needs a typed URL
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8XiE8ZJYbrmzFDtS9g

**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect, reproduced once in the console.

**Business reason.** An admin who wants to turn off one module of an installed app, such as hotcrm's Project Delivery, does it on the Packages page. Under #25098 ruling 甲, Setup keeps only the marketplace-filtered "Installed Apps" view and Studio keeps the one unfiltered door. On this boot no Studio app is served, so no menu entry anywhere opens the unfiltered page. Code-loaded packages never appear in the filtered view. The only way in is to type the URL, and app docs have to print an address instead of a click path (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2648, PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2651).

**Reach (measured once).** hotcrm main `89c4d999`, `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0, `objectstack dev`, Playwright, admin user:

- The Setup sidebar's only packages link is "Installed Apps" → `…/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace`. It shows "No apps installed from the marketplace yet", and "Show all" matches 0 times.
- The same route without the query is titled Packages, lists the 7 hotcrm packages (Source: Code) and offers Disable, which works (`PATCH …/disable` 200).
- No entry reaches that route: every Setup group, including Advanced; `/_console/studio` App Builder; a package's Data, Automations, Interfaces, Access and All metadata pillars; the home launcher.
- `/_console/apps/studio` answers "This app can't be opened", and `GET /api/v1/meta/app` lists no `studio`.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` names "Studio's Overview → Packages" as the unfiltered door.

Expected: on a boot like this one, an admin reaches the unfiltered Packages page from a menu. Either the door named in setup-nav is served, or Setup links to it when it is not. Which of the two is a product call for triage, not for this card.

**Reader.** objectstack triage grades it and routes it to the console/setup-nav lane. Not a claim; awaits triage.

**Dedupe** (`search/issues`, `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue`, open and closed):
- `unfiltered Packages door setup nav`: 49 hits. The closest are #25098 (closed: the ruling that moved the door to Studio), #34722 (closed: upgrade prompt in Installed Apps) and #28118 (closed: module rows Enable/Disable). None covers the door being unreachable.
- `Studio Packages menu entry not served`: 116 hits, none on point. The nearest are the umbrella #34571 (open) and #27928 (closed).
